subject: Confirmation of Travel Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are pleased to confirm your travel booking for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight is scheduled for [date] at [time] from [departure city] to Paris. Please make sure to arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure. For any changes or inquiries, feel free to contact our customer service team at [phone number] or reply to this email. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, Travel Agency Team
